name: Gate repair multi-file parallel, coupled and partial-recovery simulation
target: Run the production gate repair coordinator with fake attribution and PR boundaries for 15 source files
inputs: two coupled files sharing failing tests
one failed repair child among otherwise successful children
observations: each independent source starts exactly one child with at most two concurrent children
coupled files do not start children
repair feature files stay under an isolated temporary root
successful repairs remain recorded while only failed and coupled files go to HITL with unique IDs
